QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is the anti-optimisation barrier. With `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` it is an empty `asm volatile` taking `x` as an in/out register. Otherwise it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a variable the compiler cannot see the value of. Its job is to stop the compiler proving a value and turning the mask arithmetic back into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier that stops the compiler knowing/proving a value, and states that the primitives live in library/constant_time_impl.h.
